# depicts

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:depicts`](gmeow-depicts.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/depicts>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an image ([`MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md)) to an entity it depicts — the flat 80%-case shortcut, subproperty of [`gmeow:isAbout`](gmeow-isAbout.md). Non-functional: an image may depict many entities. Promote to a [`gmeow:DepictionUsage`](../classes/gmeow-DepictionUsage.md) relator when the context, audience, period, confidence, or evidence of the depiction must be recorded.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the 80% case of an image depicting an entity — the flat shortcut subproperty of [`gmeow:isAbout`](gmeow-isAbout.md); non-functional, an image may depict many entities.

### Avoid when

- Avoid the flat form when context, audience, period, confidence, regions, or evidence of the depiction must be recorded — promote to a [`gmeow:DepictionUsage`](../classes/gmeow-DepictionUsage.md) relator (the images extension), the reified half of the pair.

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md) at each depicted [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) via [`gmeow:depicts`](gmeow-depicts.md); read the inverse with [`gmeow:depictedIn`](gmeow-depictedIn.md), and promote to [`gmeow:DepictionUsage`](../classes/gmeow-DepictionUsage.md) when the depiction needs first-class metadata.

### Examples

- ex:photo [`gmeow:depicts`](gmeow-depicts.md) ex:lillith, ex:dog.
